correctness.rationale: For any permutations the disagreement-edge graph is a nonempty star exactly when they share a single-symbol deletion read. Pairwise disagreement sets across a triple have symmetric difference zero. A three-star classification proves either a common center (one common read) or exactly the exceptional three-edge triangle, forcing three cyclic rotations of a consecutive three-symbol block. Both disjoint types are counted with no multiplicities; n=2 boundary gives zero. The detailed direct proof is in RESULT.md. An independent explicit-deletion script exhaustively corroborated n=2..6 and identity neighborhoods n=7..14.
